search.query: | mstats avg("ipmi.*temp*") as "v**" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value
| mstats avg("ipmi.*fan*") as "v**" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("ipmi.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("ipmi.*volt*","ipmi.*vcore*","ipmi.*vdd*","ipmi.*12v*","ipmi.*3v*","ipmi.*48v*","ipmi.*5v*","ipmi.*bat*","ipmi.*p1_p*") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("ipmi.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("ipmi.*watt*","ipmi.*power*","ipmi.*psu*","ipmi.*input*","ipmi.*output*") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value
| mcatalog values(metric_name) as m where index=metrics metric_name="ipmi.*" | eval count=mvcount(m)
